programmes.d: The chefs battle in a speed breakfast challenge, feeding a dining room of first responders.
Season 20 winner Trenton Garvey and his fiancée task the chefs with creating a wedding menu.
Chef Ramsay and a special guest challenge the chefs to make the perfect dish using only a wok.
It's all fun and games as the chefs compete in the first-ever 'wild game show.'
It's down to the top ten! Chef Ramsay surprises the chefs with carnival games for their next challenge.
Chef Ramsay and actor Danny Trejo challenge the chefs to a taco competition.
It's time for the sauciest Blind Taste Test Challenge ever and a world-class charity dinner service.
The chefs compete in three unique cooking challenges to receive a black jacket.
The black jacket chefs are challenged to cook dishes with ingredients from different cities.
The final four chefs compete to be in Entertainment Weekly. Chef Ramsay drops sabotages during dinner service.
The final three chefs are treated to a day of relaxation from Chef Ramsay before battling it out.
In an epic finale, find out who will be the head chef of Hell's Kitchen Atlantic City!
The contestants compete in the signature dish challenge after being divided into two teams.
A rocky first dinner service for both teams involves raw meat and bad communication.
Disaster strikes when raw chicken and cold steak are served.
The contestants must create elevated American comfort food dishes.
It's time for the surf-and-turf relay challenge, where the chefs will taste and identify mystery proteins.
The chefs face off in a soccer-themed fusion challenge featuring Alexi Lalas.
The chefs tackle a high-stakes barbecue challenge with Aaron Franklin as the judge.

The contestants are each assigned to cook one of the top 5 cuisines in America.
The chefs learn that running a restaurant takes more than passion when Suzanne Goin judges their dishes.
Jordan Chiles challenges the chefs to create balanced pasta dishes for Chef Evan Funke.
A new blind taste test arises. Scallop and soufflé problems at dinner service reveal the winners and losers.
Ramsay gives black jackets to the aspiring chefs. They play craps to pick dishes for the initial challenge.
After a wild night, the chefs learn how influence impacts the future.
